expectation: Rollback changes the active promoted capability baseline to v0.06.1 but never deletes v0.07 frozen, defect, experiment, regression, or evaluation evidence.
trigger_conditions: Any final mandatory gate fails after release decision.
Final shipping package or extracted-package validation reports any error, warning, missing file, extra file, size mismatch, or hash mismatch.
Frozen v0.07 contract, evaluation-plan, combined corpus, or held-out partition integrity changes.
Any active critical regression fails or disappears without governed retirement.
Post-release evidence demonstrates unsafe automatic defaults or critical ambiguity escapes attributable to v0.07.
